name: Cameron Molinares
source:
Law & Philosophy Major, Year 3

Most people would think Cameron's too anxious to goof around, never mind joke and giggle. But then again, you're not most people. They're a wallflower for sure, but around a select few, they're prone to overblown reactions and loads of comedic self esteem. If you can ease them out of their shell, you've earned every right to laugh with them.

[From [url=https://blank-house.itch.io/keyframes]itch.io[/url]]
